prompt: Can you list all the constituents of every language ever created and describe each constituent in detail?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 3 best matches the prompt’s intent by giving a structured overview of core linguistic constituents (phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, etc.) with relatively detailed definitions and examples, though it is still not exhaustive and contains some definitional redundancies/inaccuracies. Candidate 1 provides a similar high-level list but stays too general and more strongly dismisses the impossibility without truly listing/“describing each constituent” in detail. Candidate 4 is brief and largely limited to constituents of English rather than language constituents across “every language ever created.” Candidate 2 is largely irrelevant (lists languages instead of constituents) and includes clear category/confusion errors and questionable factual claims.
